WeaponsBlowpipe, broadsword, cat-o-nine-tails, cestus, club, dagger, dart, light hammer, hand axe, hand crossbow, javelin, knife, light crossbow, longsword, mace, main gauche, staff, rapier, sap, shortbow, short sword, sickle, sleeve tangler, spiked gauntlet, sling, whip
ArmourLight armour. Shields and heavier armour only through training, like any class.
BtHAbout +1 per 4 levels to 12th (+2), then the Knight track from 13th (+7 at 13th, +15 at 24th)
IdentityA skill expert and opportunist: locks, traps, scouting and talk, then a vicious strike from behind when the moment comes.

Rogue Progression Table

These values apply from the listed level until the next row. Exploit's dice stay smaller than the Assassin's Sneak Attack because its trigger is easier to meet.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

LvlYou gain
1Rogue Skills, Back Attack, Exploit (Sneak Attack), Precise Strikes, Hide and Move Silently
2Cunning Step, Hit and Run
3Dirty Fighting, Hide and Move Silently together, Detect Secret/Concealed Doors
4Evasive Manoeuvre
5Cut and Run (Extra Attack), Thief Skills (Master)
6Skill Mastery
7Evasion, Uncanny Dodge
8Sixth Sense
9Dirty Fighting improves, kit improves
13Knight attack track, Precise Strikes improves
15+1 Dexterity
17No fast-movement penalty to Hide or Move Silently
18Slippery
20Evasive Manoeuvre improves, Renown: Guild House
24Perfect Timing, Unpenalised Hide and Move Silently

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Cant — a coded thieves' language
  • Thief Skills: Trained in Lockpicking, Traps, Pick Pocket and Climb (Book II), on top of your 3 starting skills, and Master in all four from 5th level. You roll Climb with Dexterity.
  • Decipher Script (Intelligence): 2d8 minutes per page; arcane script is a Hard check to read (you cannot cast it); never works on divine scrolls

Back Attack

  • Effect: Once per round, when you hit a creature that cannot see you with a light or finesse melee weapon, multiply the weapon's damage dice (double at 1st level, rising to sextuple at 20th: see the Rogue Progression Table).

Exploit (Sneak Attack)

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (1d6 at 1st level, rising to 4d6 at 23rd: see the Rogue Progression Table) against a creature that is flanked, in melee with one of your allies and not with you, Restrained, Prone, or that cannot see you, once per round. Usable at range within 30ft, doesn't require a prior stealth check, can't combine with Back Attack.

Precise Strikes

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage per three Rogue levels (minimum +1), and from 13th level +1 per two Rogue levels. This applies to every hit, not only Exploits.

Hide and Move Silently

  • Effect: Normal roll at half speed or under, disadvantage above half speed, impossible to attempt while running or charging. You count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
  • Listen: disadvantage when listening through any solid barrier

2nd Level

Cunning Step

  • Effect: Once per round, you may move away from a creature in melee reach without provoking opportunity attacks.

Hit and Run

  • Effect: On a turn you make an attack, your speed increases by 10ft (20ft from 13th level). Once per round, you can move through one enemy's space. Moving through that space doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

3rd Level

  • Attempting Hide and Move Silently together imposes Disadvantage on both checks, at quarter speed

Detect Secret/Concealed Doors

  • Effect: Advantage on checks to find secret or concealed doors, plus a free check whenever you pass within 10ft of one.

Dirty Fighting

  • Effect: Advantage on Dirty Trick, Disarm and Trip contests (see Combat Manoeuvres in The Arneyan Codex), and you may use Dexterity for all three.
  • 9th level: once per round, when your Exploit hits, you may make one of them against that creature as part of the hit

4th Level

Evasive Manoeuvre

  • Effect: The first melee attack against you each round has Disadvantage. It doesn't work in a round you make a ranged attack, or while you are surprised.
  • 20th level: the first two melee attacks against you each round have Disadvantage

5th Level

Cut and Run

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage against a creature next to one of your allies; your movement this turn then doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from it.
  • Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.

6th Level

Skill Mastery

  • Effect: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 when using your Rogue Skills, Thief Skills included.

7th Level

Evasion

  • Effect: When you succeed on a Reflex save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, you take none. If you fail, you take half.

Uncanny Dodge

  • Effect: Once per round, when an attacker you can see hits you, halve the damage.

8th Level

  • Sixth Sense: Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised

15th Level

  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity

17th Level

  • The disadvantage from moving fast while hiding or moving silently is removed entirely

18th Level

  • Slippery: Evasive Manoeuvre also works on a round you make a ranged attack.

20th Level

Renown: Guild House

  • Effect: You may found a guild house (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d6 apprentice thieves and a fence join it. While you hold it, you have Advantage on checks to gather information in its city.

24th Level

  • Hide and Move Silently are fully unpenalised even while running or charging

Perfect Timing

  • Effect: Once per encounter, act first in the round, whatever initiative says.

Kits: Arneyan Thief Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Rogue folder. Drag one onto your character.

Rogue Kits represent the network, upbringing, or tradition that shaped the character's criminal trade.
